entities.summary: Portuguese, a notable figure in the history of Malaysia, associated with Sultanate of Malacca (1445–1511). Preceded by Golden Age and Portuguese Conquest and Zheng He's treasure fleet visits Malacca, establishing Ming protection. Their legacy influenced Afonso de Albuquerque conquers Malacca for Portugal.
